title: High availability, failover and journal quorum assurance
workflow: Detect degradation and determine failed consistency boundary
Fence failed writer before promoting replacement
Validate candidate replica commit/watermark and audit consistency
Promote leader under documented quorum policy
Replay outstanding events with inbox deduplication and unknown-outcome quarantine
Reconcile journal and external obligations before restoring sensitive traffic
invariants: Prevent split-brain posting through fencing and unique writer ownership
Failover cannot alter historical posted journals
Replica freshness is measured, never inferred from availability
Unknown settlement remains unknown until source evidence exists
Bank-specific RPO/RTO values require approved measured exercises
HSM credentials and rail entitlements do not transfer implicitly
All failover decisions and promoted generations are audited
acceptance_tests: Simultaneous writer attempt rejects stale fencing epoch
Crash after journal commit preserves exactly one posting
Lagging replica cannot certify zero data loss
External payment timeout cannot trigger blind replay
Reconciliation gate blocks reopening on journal imbalance
independent_gate: Qualified CFO/Operations review, realistic failure environment and measured HA/DR acceptance evidence.
